docs.summary: A non-solid sensor volume. It does not collide with or push anything; instead it queries the physics world each fixed step for overlapping rigidbodies and raises enter/stay/exit events. Use it for pickups, checkpoints, damage zones, detectors, and similar gameplay triggers. Only bodies that can be identified (a [`Rigidbody3D`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Rigidbody3D)) are reported. Static geometry shares a per-layer body and has no component to hand back, so it is ignored. [`CharacterController`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.CharacterController)s have no body, so they are tested directly and reported through the separate character callbacks.
Local-space offset of the volume from the GameObject's origin. As [`Center`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Collider~Center).
Euler rotation of the volume relative to the GameObject, in degrees. As [`Rotation`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Collider~Rotation).
Box full extents (width, height, depth). Used when [`Shape`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.TriggerVolume~Shape) is Box.
Radius. Used by every shape except Box.
Total height along the local up axis, caps included for a capsule. Used by Capsule, Cylinder and Cone, and means the same thing as the matching collider's Height.
The rigidbodies currently inside the volume.
The character controllers currently inside the volume.
Called when the object becomes enabled and active. Only called when the GameObject is in a Scene and enabled.
Called when the object becomes disabled or inactive. Only called when the GameObject was in a Scene and becomes disabled.
Called for rendering and handling GUI gizmos.
